cues.text: On the Kirijo family's private beach, you stand by a parasol with Junpei and Akihiko. Yukari, Fuuka, Mitsuru and Aigis walk over to join you.
Junpei runs off into the sea, and Aigis dashes in after him with a splash. Yukari laughs and heads down to the water with Aigis.
Fuuka and Mitsuru follow them into the water. Later, you and Akihiko sit on beach loungers under a parasol, Akihiko with his arms folded and legs crossed, and Ikutsuki walks over to you.
Out in the shallows, Aigis aims her arm at Junpei and a jet of water blasts from her fingertips straight into him. Yukari grins and drops into a fighting stance, and so do you.
Akihiko and you rush in too. Junpei ends up sprawled face down in the shallows, everyone standing over him.
